title: bbox_gaps list responses are chronically over-cap: no pagination, field projection, or summary mode
wanted_capability: bbox_gaps should shape its output at the producer instead of relying on the blanket MCP response cap. Today a full survey (json=true, limit=500) returns every row with complete wanted_capability, notes, evidence, and fallback text: measured 193,029 and 172,780 characters on two consecutive 2026-08-19 calls against a ~100-row backlog, both over the cap and spilled to response-dumps. The gap backlog manager (and any agent triaging gaps) must then burn a turn reading the spill file with jq just to get counts or ids. Wanted: (1) a compact default projection (id, title, resolution, impact, blocking_level, domain, dedupe_key, updated_at) with full fields only on exact-id lookup or an explicit include_full flag, and (2) cursor or offset pagination so large stores page instead of spilling.
missing_primitive: Compact default projection (id, title, resolution, impact, blocking_level, domain, dedupe_key, updated_at) with opt-in full-row expansion, plus cursor pagination over large result sets.
fallback_used: Read the spill file with jq to extract counts and ids; every survey round burns a spill write plus shell reads to answer basic backlog questions.
evidence: sibling instance gap-55be3518 (bro_wait envelope), sibling compact-default gap-791d1497 (hybrid search)
notes: Filed by the gap manager 2026-08-19 after the operator pointed out the obvious: the gap listing itself is unreadable at backlog scale. Substrate-genuine: any project with a triple-digit gap backlog hits the spill on every full survey. Instance of umbrella gap-ecff3899.
